callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to an existing project directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialised against the project directory if the CodeGraph index can be created; returns None otherwise.

callees.name: get_function_spans
callees.signature: get_function_spans(language: str, filepath: str) -> list | None
callees.pre_condition: Called on a valid CodeGraphExtractor instance. language is a string identifying the target programming language and filepath is a string path to a source file.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (name, start_idx, end_idx) tuples for each function in the specified file where indices are 0-indexed and inclusive, or None if the file is not indexed by the backend.
